Both Phase 3s test once-monthly oral MK-8527 as HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (conditions: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis), and the registry indexes them only under Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome, which shares no word with the sponsor's. The pair is MeSH's Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (D065129), the sponsor's own condition, not HIV Infections: the people it is given to do not have HIV, and HIV Infections already carries the 1,103,895 living with diagnosed HIV that Idvynso is valued on, so one disease would hold two populations.
ZENITH High Proteinuria studies chronic kidney disease with high proteinuria; the registry's only descriptor is Kidney Diseases, which TOO_BROAD refuses.
ABP 234 is studied against pembrolizumab in advanced or metastatic and early-stage non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer, and the registry carries no MeSH descriptor on either study.
Danon disease is MeSH's Glycogen Storage Disease Type IIb (LAMP2 deficiency), which shares no word with the sponsor's 'Danon Disease' but the word disease.

Both studies name Dravet Syndrome as their only condition and the registry indexes them under Epilepsies, Myoclonic (D004831) alone, which shares no word with the sponsor's. MeSH lists Dravet Syndrome (term T812423) as an entry term of D004831 (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=D004831, checked 2026-10-12), so the descriptor is the disease. The descriptor also covers other myoclonic epilepsies (Doose syndrome among them); the seed's pool is Dravet syndrome with an SCN1A variant only.

A container for the seed's pool, not the disease: MeSH has no concept for SCN2A or SCN8A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. The NDA is for SCN2A and SCN8A DEEs and rests on EMBOLD (NCT05818553), whose conditions, SCN2A Encephalopathy and SCN8A Encephalopathy, the registry indexes under no MeSH term at all. EMERALD (NCT07010471), in broad DEEs, lists its condition as Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy 1 and the registry indexes it under C567924, the supplementary concept for the X-linked infantile spasm disease (DEE1, caused by ARX), whose entry terms also include Early Infantile Epileptic Encephalopathy and Ohtahara Syndrome (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=C567924, checked 2026-10-14). No other seed sits on it, so the population guard holds one figure for it: the two genetic diseases the NDA names, 9,000 people at Praxis's own count, and not the ARX disease the name describes.

BROADWAY (NCT05142722), BROOKLYN (NCT05425745) and TANDEM (NCT06005597), the three Phase 3 studies the European authorisation for primary hypercholesterolaemia rests on (8-K 0001193125-26-396716), each name Hypercholesterolemia as a condition, but the book holds them as completed studies with no MeSH terms, so the derivation pairs nothing from them. PREVAIL (NCT05202509), the outcomes study in ASCVD patients whose LDL-C is not controlled on maximally tolerated lipid-lowering therapy (10-Q 0001193125-26-333824), is indexed only under Atherosclerosis, which shares no word with the sponsor's 'Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease' once 'disease' is set aside as generic (indication_mapping.tokens reads 'atherosclerotic' and 'atherosclerosi').

column6: The study treats moderate to severe upper facial lines in adults, Part 1 glabellar lines, with the primary endpoint none or mild on the Allergan Glabellar Lines Severity Scale at Day 7 (registry, clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28), and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term, as it does 96 of the first 100 glabellar lines studies it returns. MeSH has no descriptor for facial lines; Skin Aging (D015595) carries Skin Wrinkling as an entry term (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=D015595, checked 2026-10-28), so it is the disease.

The master protocol gives inebilizumab only in Subprotocol A, adults with active refractory SLE with biopsy-proven class III or IV lupus nephritis; blinatumomab alone takes Subprotocol B (SLE) and Subprotocol C, the only rheumatoid arthritis arm (registry arms and eligibility, checked 2026-10-28; data/asset_indication_exclusions.csv already removes the rheumatoid arthritis pair on the same reading). The row is the asset's SLE row, the sponsor's own condition. MeSH's Lupus Nephritis (D008181) is narrower and fits Subprotocol A, but naming it would build a second pair from this one study beside the SLE pair it already makes.

The master protocol gives inebilizumab only in Subprotocol A, adults with active refractory SLE with biopsy-proven class III or IV lupus nephritis; blinatumomab alone takes Subprotocol B (SLE) and Subprotocol C, the only rheumatoid arthritis arm (registry arms and eligibility, checked 2026-10-28; data/asset_indication_exclusions.csv already removes the rheumatoid arthritis pair on the same reading). The row is the asset's SLE row, the sponsor's own condition. MeSH's Lupus Nephritis (D008181) is narrower and fits Subprotocol A, but naming it would build a second pair from this one study beside the SLE pair it already makes. The same row under Uplizna, the brand the alias map folds inebilizumab into, so it resolves on either name.

SUMMIT tests AXS-05 against bupropion and placebo for smoking cessation in adults, primary endpoint 4-week continuous abstinence at Weeks 9 to 12 (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The sponsor's only condition is Smoking Cessation (D016540), the asset's own row; Smoking (D012907) is the behaviour the study stops, not the endpoint.

DESTINY-Breast09 enrols first-line HER2-positive advanced or metastatic breast cancer, HR-positive or HR-negative, primary endpoint PFS by BICR (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The disease is Breast Neoplasms (D001943), the asset's own row; Breast Diseases (D001941) is its parent and Neoplasm Metastasis a stage.

The study enrols adults with a DSM-5-TR diagnosis of bipolar I disorder in an acute manic episode, with or without mixed features, on lithium, valproate or lamotrigine, primary endpoint change in YMRS at Week 5 (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The disease is Bipolar Disorder (D001714). Mania (D000087122) is the episode, and MeSH files it under Neurobehavioral Manifestations (tree numbers C23.888.592.604.487, C10.597.606.483, F01.700.548, read from id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh on 2026-10-28), a sign rather than a disease.

The Phase 2/3 switches adults with HIV-1 virologically suppressed on Biktarvy to weekly oral lepetegravir with lenacapavir pacfosacil, primary endpoint HIV-1 RNA of 50 copies/mL or more at Week 24 and Week 48 (registry, checked 2026-10-28); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The disease is HIV Infections (D015658, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/descriptor, checked 2026-10-28), the descriptor the book's other HIV treatment pairs sit on.

Both Phase 3s test INCA034176 (axatilimab) in chronic graft-versus-host disease: AXemplify-357 as initial treatment with corticosteroids, primary endpoint event-free survival, and NCT06821542 against best available therapy after at least two prior lines, primary endpoint objective response at 6 months, both from 12 years (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The registry indexes both only under Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome, the lung form of chronic GVHD and not the population enrolled. MeSH has no chronic GVHD descriptor; Graft vs Host Disease (D006086, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28) is the disease.

DAWN-303 compares mFOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel with or without INCB161734 in previously untreated KRAS G12D-mutated metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, primary endpoints OS, PFS and response (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The registry indexes it under Pancreatic Neoplasms (D010190), which the asset has no row for because its only rows come from hepatic and renal impairment PK studies. Carcinoma, Pancreatic Ductal (D021441) is narrower; D010190 keeps it on the descriptor the registry gives pancreatic cancer studies across the book.

The first-in-human dose escalation and expansion study of the DLL3 CAR-T is titled for extensive stage small cell lung cancer, and its primary endpoints are safety and the recommended Phase 2 dose (registry, checked 2026-10-28); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The disease is Small Cell Lung Carcinoma (D055752, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28). Inclusion also admits large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma, a DLL3-expressing neighbour the title does not name.

KEYNOTE-676 tests pembrolizumab with BCG in high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, persistent or recurrent after BCG induction (Cohort A, complete response rate) or BCG naive (Cohort B, event-free survival) (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The registry indexes it only under C565324, Parkinson Disease 4, Autosomal Dominant Lewy Body, which is an indexing error. The row is the asset's bladder row, Urinary Bladder Neoplasms (D001749), which already holds Keytruda's approval in BCG-unresponsive high-risk NMIBC (label set id 9333c79b-d487-4538-a9f0-71b91a02b287, effective 2026-07-10, checked 2026-10-28). MeSH's narrower Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Neoplasms (D000093284) exists and is not used, so the NMIBC approval and this readout stay on one row.

The Phase 3 vaccinates healthy adults 18 and over with two doses of the H5 pandemic influenza vaccine against placebo, primary endpoints HAI titre and seroconversion at Day 43 (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The disease the vaccine prevents is Influenza, Human (D007251), the asset's own row; Influenza in Birds (D005585) is the animal disease the H5 strain comes from.

MAGNITUDE-2 enrols adults with hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis with polyneuropathy (ATTRv-PN), primary endpoints mNIS+7 at 18 months and serum TTR (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The disease is Amyloid Neuropathies, Familial (D028227), the asset's own row, whose entry terms include Familial Amyloid Polyneuropathy and the Portuguese (Andrade) type (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=D028227, checked 2026-10-28). The cardiomyopathy study goes on the asset's C567782 row, so the two populations stay apart.

MAGNITUDE enrols adults with transthyretin amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM), wild-type or variant, with heart failure and NT-proBNP of 600 to 10,000 pg/mL, primary endpoint CV mortality and CV events (registry, checked 2026-10-28). MeSH has no ATTR-CM or wild-type TTR concept. C567782, the asset's own row, carries Transthyretin Amyloidosis and Familial Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis as entry terms (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=C567782, checked 2026-10-28), so it is the nearest concept; its preferred name says hereditary, and the wild-type patients sit inside it only through the Transthyretin Amyloidosis entry term.

All four test Pfizer's RSV prefusion F vaccine to prevent RSV disease (registry, checked 2026-10-28): RENOIR in adults 60 and over, primary endpoint RSV lower respiratory tract illness (NCT05035212); India in adults 18 and over (NCT07653100); China and the US in adults 60 and over (NCT07819097); and revaccination in subsequent pregnancies, women 18 to 49 vaccinated with their infants followed (NCT06866405). The registry indexes only the last, under Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infections (D018357), which is the disease for all four.

SKYGLO compares glofitamab with Pola-R-CHP against Pola-R-CHP in previously untreated CD20-positive large B-cell lymphoma, primary endpoint PFS (registry, checked 2026-10-28); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The row is the asset's only lymphoma row. Lymphoma, Large B-Cell, Diffuse (D016403) is the narrower disease, but a D016403 pair on Columvi would make indication_mapping.drop_parent_of_child delete the Lymphoma, Non-Hodgkin row, which carries its approval in relapsed or refractory DLBCL (label set id 3516e753-f064-4d30-9bd5-e3f2e143f75d, effective 2026-06-25, checked 2026-10-28).

The Phase 1/2 gives single-dose intrathecal ST-503 against sham to adults with small fiber neuropathy by ACTTION criteria whose pain is refractory to 2 of 3 first-line classes, primary endpoint TEAEs at 12 weeks (registry, checked 2026-10-28). The registry indexes it under Small Fiber Neuropathy (D000071075), the population the inclusion criteria define; the sponsor's Chronic Neuropathic Pain is the symptom being treated.

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with uncontrolled gout (the only condition) and compares subcutaneous with intravenous pegloticase, both with weekly methotrexate, on sustained serum uric acid below 6 mg/dL in Month 6; it indexes no MeSH term. The disease is MeSH's Gout (D006073, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

CLEAR: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols ages 12 and older with CT-confirmed bronchiectasis and chronic Pseudomonas aeruginosa colonisation, with the annualised rate of bronchiectasis exacerbations as the primary outcome, and indexes no MeSH term. The disease is Bronchiectasis (D001987, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28); the colonisation is an entry criterion, not the disease read out. Adolescents and adults enrol together, so it is not a paediatric study.

BIFANG: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols Chinese adults with chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, single-arm tezepelumab, primary outcomes nasal polyp score and nasal congestion score at Week 24, and indexes no MeSH term. CRSwNP is the asset's Rhinosinusitis row (D000096825, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests BNT166a, which the official title calls an mpox mRNA vaccine candidate, in healthy adults aged 18 to 64 in African countries, primary outcomes reactogenicity and safety. Smallpox and Orthopoxvirus Infection are listed because the antigens are orthopoxvirus antigens, but no smallpox endpoint or population is in the protocol, so the disease is Mpox, Monkeypox (D045908), the asset's row.

EDGE-Lung: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) is a Phase 2 platform in stage IV metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with ORR as the primary outcome; quemliclustat is given in arms A3, B1, B3 and C1, and the other arms test domvanalimab with zimberelimab. It indexes no MeSH term; the disease is Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung (D002289, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

MonumenTAL-1: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma by IMWG criteria in every Part 3 cohort, primary outcome ORR. The condition is typed as Hematological Malignancies, which the registry indexes as Hematologic Neoplasms beside Multiple Myeloma (D009101); the disease is the asset's Multiple Myeloma row.

CONTRAST-NP: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols ages 12 and older with chronic rhinosinusitis with bilateral nasal polyps on intranasal corticosteroids, primary outcomes nasal congestion score and endoscopic nasal polyp score at Week 24, and indexes no MeSH term. The disease is MeSH's Rhinosinusitis (D000096825, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28), the descriptor Tezspire's CRSwNP row uses; adolescents join the adult study open-label, so it is not a paediatric study.

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests MK-6916 against placebo and hydrocodone/acetaminophen for acute pain after primary unilateral bunionectomy, primary outcome SPID48. The condition is typed as Pain Management, which the registry indexes as Agnosia (D000377), a mis-indexing. The disease is MeSH's Postoperative Pain (D010149, formerly Pain, Postoperative, which carries Acute Postoperative Pain as an entry term; id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details, checked 2026-10-28).

Nova 301: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests mRNA-1403 against placebo in adults 18 and older, with vaccine efficacy against moderate or severe norovirus acute gastroenteritis of vaccine-matched genotypes as the efficacy primary outcome; it indexes no MeSH term. MeSH holds norovirus disease under Caliciviridae Infections (D017250), whose entry terms include Norovirus Infections (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details, checked 2026-10-28); Gastroenteritis (D005759) would also take every non-norovirus cause.

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria inadequately controlled by second generation antihistamines, primary outcome UAS7 at Week 12. The registry indexes it under Chronic Urticaria, its parent Urticaria and Pruritus; the disease is Chronic Urticaria (D000080223), the narrower of the asset's two urticaria rows.

Tranquillo 2: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with active or stable nonsegmental vitiligo, primary outcomes F-VASI75 and T-VASI50 at Week 52, and indexes no MeSH term. The disease is the asset's Vitiligo row (D014820).

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols from 1 day to 18 years with a gain-of-function SCN2A variant and seizure onset before 3 months, primary outcome seizure frequency at 24 weeks, and indexes it under Epilepsy (D004827) and Seizures. Early-onset SCN2A DEE is a disease of infancy with no adult population to keep apart and no MeSH concept of its own (none on id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28), so the readout links to the asset's only row, Epilepsy, as the registry indexes it; the seed's pool on that row is early-onset SCN2A DEE only.

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with primary immune thrombocytopenia in both: the Japanese continuation study after LUNA 3 (NCT07216079, primary outcome adverse events) and LUNA 4 (NCT07007962, after failed first-line treatment, primary outcome durable platelet response), and indexes both under Purpura, Thrombocytopenic, Idiopathic (D016553), whose entry terms include Immune Thrombocytopenia (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details, checked 2026-10-28). The asset carries no ITP row, though the FDA label (api.fda.gov/drug/label set id 95ffd367-9b0c-4f75-8487-5d8f3c0a5ad0, effective 2025-08-26) approves Wayrilz in persistent or chronic ITP in adults, so the row creates the pair.

ADVANCE EXTENSION: the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with WHO Group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension who completed a prior ralinepag study, primary outcome treatment-emergent adverse events. The registry indexes it under seven of the asset's rows because the sponsor listed their names as conditions; WHO Group 1 PAH is Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (D000081029), the narrowest of them, and the others are its parents or the connective tissue disease subgroup it admits.

the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults aged 18 to 80 with pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy in all three: the placebo- and pregabalin-controlled Phase 3 (NCT06628908) and the placebo-controlled Phase 3 (NCT07231419), both on weekly NPRS at Week 12, and their open-label safety extension (NCT06696443). None is indexed under a MeSH term. The disease is Diabetic Neuropathies (D003929), whose entry terms include Diabetic Neuropathy, Painful (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details, checked 2026-10-28), not the asset's Pain row: the FDA label (set id d229cf71-96ec-4206-960b-d56fafc250ac, effective 2026-07-21) approves Journavx in moderate to severe acute pain only, so a DPN readout on that row would read as deciding the approved indication.

GLORIOSA enrols FRalpha-high, platinum-sensitive, high-grade serous epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal or fallopian tube cancer as one population with one PFS primary (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under Ovarian Neoplasms and Fallopian Tube Neoplasms, both rows of the asset. The disease is the asset's narrowest row, Carcinoma, Ovarian Epithelial (D000077216, entry term Epithelial Ovarian Cancer), which the eligibility names.

An open-label extension in ATTR amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy, wild-type and hereditary (keywords wtATTR and hATTR), for patients from APOLLO-B, ALN-TTR02-014 and HELIOS-B (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry gives it the HELIOS-B set: Amyloidosis, Hereditary, Transthyretin-Related (C567782, MeSH maps it to Amyloid Neuropathies, Familial), Cardiomyopathies and Amyloidosis. HELIOS-A, in hereditary polyneuropathy, carries C567782 too and does not carry Amyloidosis, so Amyloidosis (D000686) is the row that is cardiomyopathy alone, and the only one that covers wild-type disease.

Efgartigimod IV against placebo in adults with primary immune thrombocytopenia of more than 12 months, platelet count under 30 x 10^9/L (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry indexes it under Purpura, Thrombocytopenic, Idiopathic (D016553), the asset's own row, whose MeSH entry terms include Immune Thrombocytopenia; the sponsor's 'Primary Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)' shares too few words with the descriptor for the derivation to pair them.

The open-label extension of ARGX-113-2004 (ADVANCE SC) in adults with primary immune thrombocytopenia (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)), indexed under Purpura, Thrombocytopenic, Idiopathic (D016553), whose MeSH entry terms include Immune Thrombocytopenia (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=D016553, checked 2026-10-28). The asset has no ITP row, so the row creates the pair.

Efgartigimod PH20 SC against placebo in adults with primary Sjogren's disease meeting the 2016 ACR/EULAR criteria, clinESSDAI of at least 6 and anti-Ro/SS-A positive, primary endpoint change in clinESSDAI at week 48 (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH's Sjogren's Syndrome (D012859, entry term Sjogren Syndrome, checked 2026-10-28) is the disease; secondary Sjogren's is excluded.

The open-label extension of ARGX-113-2007 (ALKIVIA) for adults with active idiopathic inflammatory myopathy, open to completers whatever their subtype (dermatomyositis, polymyositis or IMNM, antisynthetase syndrome) (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The protocol's disease is IIM as one, and Myositis (D009220) is MeSH's descriptor for it: Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathy is its entry term (checked 2026-10-28). The subtype rows, Dermatomyositis, Polymyositis and Antisynthetase syndrome, are parts of it.

A Phase IIb of a single dose of AZD5148 against placebo to prevent recurrence of Clostridioides difficile infection in adults treated for a qualifying, toxin-positive episode, primary endpoint first recurrence (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry's Clostridium Infections (D003015) is the disease: MeSH lists Clostridioides difficile Infection as its entry term (checked 2026-10-28), though it shares no word with the sponsor's but 'infection'.

SOHO-02: first-line sevabertinib against pembrolizumab with platinum and pemetrexed in locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with an activating HER2 tyrosine kinase domain mutation, primary endpoint PFS by BICR (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term, and the disease is Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung (D002289).

RESET-Myositis treats active idiopathic inflammatory myopathy: adult cohorts (18 to 75) in dermatomyositis, antisynthetase syndrome and IMNM, with Phase 2b sub-studies in DM with ASyS and in IMNM, and a juvenile cohort (6 to 17) in JIIM, all on a clinical diagnosis of IIM by the 2017 EULAR/ACR criteria (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). Myositis (D009220) is MeSH's descriptor for IIM (entry term Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathy). The juvenile cohort puts the paediatric word in the title, but the study enrols both ages and CABA-201 has no approval, so the readout decides the indication itself rather than a paediatric layer on an approved one.

A single-arm Phase 3 of once-yearly intramuscular lenacapavir for HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis in HIV-negative people aged 16 and over with an indication for PrEP (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The pair is Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (D065129), as for MK-8527, not HIV Infections: the people it is given to do not have HIV, and HIV Infections already carries the treatment population.

A Phase 1/2 in healthy volunteers and then patients with urea cycle disorders of any enzyme (OTC, CPS1, NAGS, ASS1, ASL, arginase 1, ORNT1, citrin), since KRRO-121 edits glutamine synthetase to clear ammonia independently of the defect (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The protocol's disease is UCD as one, which is Urea Cycle Disorders, Inborn (D056806), the asset's row; OTC deficiency and NAGS deficiency are two of its subtypes.

GZP2, the type 2 diabetes study of the GZPO master protocol: adults with BMI of at least 25 and type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 7% to 10%, primary endpoint change in HbA1c; the brief summary states the purpose is glycaemic control, and body weight is a secondary (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The disease is Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2 (D003924).

ATTAIN-Hypertension (GZL1): orforglipron against placebo for treatment of hypertension in adults with obesity or overweight, primary endpoint change in office systolic blood pressure, body weight a secondary (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The disease is Hypertension (D006973); obesity is the population it is tested in.

TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 5 enrols early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease (MMSE 20 to 28, amyloid positive), primary endpoint iADRS (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry's Dementia and Cognitive Dysfunction are co-indexing of the same patients; the disease is Alzheimer Disease (D000544).

TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 7 enrols early cognitive decline with at least one core clinical feature of dementia with Lewy bodies and CSF-confirmed alpha-synuclein and amyloid co-pathology, primary endpoint CDR-SB (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The disease is Lewy Body Disease (D020961), whose MeSH entry terms include Dementia, Lewy Body (checked 2026-10-28); Cognitive Dysfunction describes the stage, not the disease.

Suvorexant against placebo for DSM-5 insomnia disorder in adults with opioid use disorder on stable medication for it, primary endpoint polysomnographic total sleep time at week 8 (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry's Sleep Initiation and Maintenance Disorders (D007319), entry terms Insomnia and Insomnia Disorder, is the disease; opioid use disorder is the population.

MK-7262 alone and with enlicitide against placebo in adults with Lp(a) of at least 150 nmol/L on a stable statin, primary endpoints percent change in Lp(a) and in LDL-C at week 8 (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH has no descriptor for elevated Lp(a): its supplementary concept Lipoprotein Types--Lp System Lp(A) Hyperlipoproteinemia (C563617) maps to Hyperlipoproteinemias (D006951), conditions with abnormally elevated lipoproteins, which is the row (both checked 2026-10-28).

A Phase 2 dose-finding study in adults with Lp(a) of at least 150 nmol/L and ASCVD or type 2 diabetes, primary endpoints time-averaged change in Lp(a) (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The registry's Cardiovascular Diseases, Atherosclerosis, Hyperlipidemias and Dyslipidemias describe the risk setting and the lipid family; the disease enrolled is elevated Lp(a), which MeSH's C563617 maps to Hyperlipoproteinemias (D006951), the same row as MK-7262's Lp(a) study.

Both are rimegepant prevention studies in migraine (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)), neither indexed under a MeSH term: intermittent perimenstrual prevention of menstrual migraine in women 18 to 45 (NCT06641466, primary endpoint perimenstrual migraine days) and daily prevention of chronic migraine in adults (NCT07729462, primary endpoint monthly migraine days). MeSH has no menstrual or chronic migraine descriptor, so both are Migraine Disorders (D008881), the asset's row.

An open-label Phase 3 of RSVpreF revaccination in immunocompromised adults, by prior Abrysvo history, primary endpoints reactogenicity and RSV A and B neutralising titres (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term, and the disease the vaccine prevents is Respiratory Syncytial Virus Infections (D018357).

C-POST: adjuvant cemiplimab against placebo after surgery and radiation in high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, primary endpoint DFS (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH's Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma (D000099314, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup/details?descriptor=D000099314, checked 2026-10-28) is the disease; the asset has no CSCC row.

A single dose of baloxavir against placebo as post-exposure prophylaxis in household contacts aged 5 and over in China, primary endpoint RT-PCR confirmed influenza with fever and a respiratory symptom (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)). The disease is Influenza, Human (D007251); Respiratory Tract Infections is its parent. The label already approves PEP from 5 years (api.fda.gov/drug/label set id e49e1a61-1b7c-4be5-ac84-af6240b511e7).

AMPLITUDE enrols ages 10 to 65 with an APOL1 G1/G1, G2/G2 or G1/G2 genotype and proteinuric kidney disease, diabetes excluded, primary endpoints UPCR at week 48 and eGFR slope (the registry (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-28)); the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH has no concept for APOL1-mediated kidney disease, and FSGS (D005923, the Phase 2a's descriptor) is narrower than the population; persistent proteinuria with falling eGFR is chronic kidney disease, as for ZENITH, so the row is Renal Insufficiency, Chronic (D051436), and the seed must narrow it to the APOL1 high-risk genotype.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) randomises adults with moderate to severe nasolabial folds in China to the NOA LIFT hyaluronic acid filler or JUVEDERM VOLIFT with lidocaine, primary outcome responders on the Nasolabial Fold Severity Scale, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH has no disease concept for nasolabial folds: Nasolabial Fold (D060052, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28) is an anatomy descriptor (tree A01.456.505.682), named because it is exactly what the study treats; Skin Aging (D015595, entry term Skin Wrinkling) is the broader alternative and covers all skin ageing.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) compares ABP 938 8 mg with EYLEA HD in neovascular age-related macular degeneration, primary outcome change in ETDRS letter score, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. Neovascular AMD is MeSH's Wet Macular Degeneration (D057135, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) treats severe, refractory systemic lupus erythematosus with active lupus nephritis, its only condition is Lupus Nephritis, and its primary outcome is complete renal response, so the readout is in the kidney disease, not in SLE as a whole. It enrols ages 12 to 65; the FDA label on api.fda.gov/drug/label (set id 4fef6986-b988-45e4-8c20-b14f0ef1f538, effective 2026-06-23) approves Aucatzyl only in adult B-cell precursor ALL, so not in lupus at any age.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests baxdrostat 2 mg against placebo in Chinese adults with uncontrolled hypertension on two or more antihypertensives, primary outcome 24-hour ambulatory systolic blood pressure at week 12, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The disease is the asset's Hypertension row, not Hyperaldosteronism: the study selects on blood pressure, not on aldosterone excess.

AVANZAR (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) is first-line Dato-DXd with durvalumab and carboplatin against pembrolizumab with platinum chemotherapy in stage IIIB to IV NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations. The registry indexes it under Carcinoma, Non-Small-Cell Lung (D002289), the asset's own row, but the sponsor's only condition is 'NSCLC', which shares no word with the descriptor.

LAVENDER (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with chronic and/or subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus refractory to antimalarials, its only condition is Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus and its primary outcome is CLASI-70. The registry also indexes Lupus Erythematosus, Discoid (D008179), which is one chronic form inside the study; the disease is the parent, Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous (D008178), since subacute CLE is enrolled too.

IRIS (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with active proliferative lupus nephritis, its only condition is Lupus Nephritis and its primary outcome is complete renal response (UPCR and eGFR), so the readout is in Lupus Nephritis (D008181), not in the systemic lupus row the registry also indexes.

The roll-over study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) continues darolutamide for participants of any Bayer-sponsored darolutamide feeder study, enrols men only, and gives 'Cancer' as its condition, indexed under Neoplasms. A registry search of darolutamide studies with Bayer as lead sponsor (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) returns only prostate cancer studies among those that treat patients (the rest are healthy-volunteer or pharmacology studies), and the DailyMed label (set id 1a7cb212-56e4-4b9d-a73d-bfee7fe4735e, published 2026-10-06, checked 2026-10-28) approves Nubeqa in nmCRPC and mCSPC only, so the feeder population is prostate cancer.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) switches virologically suppressed adults with HIV-1 from Biktarvy to injectable GS-3242 with lenacapavir, primary outcome HIV-1 RNA of 50 copies/mL or more by the FDA snapshot algorithm, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. The disease is HIV Infections (D015658, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) gives one dose of dTpa to healthy Japanese women at 27 to 36 weeks of pregnancy, and both primary outcomes are pertussis antibodies (anti-PT, anti-FHA, anti-PRN) in the mother and in cord blood; no primary outcome measures diphtheria or tetanus, the two rows the registry indexes. The DailyMed label (set id cd98bff9-4602-4268-d68d-029a14a5513b, published 2026-07-23, checked 2026-10-28) indicates Boostrix in the third trimester 'to prevent pertussis in infants younger than 2 months', so the disease is Whooping Cough (D014917, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

AZALEA (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) gives nipocalimab or placebo to pregnant women with a history of severe hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn and current alloantibodies above critical titre, primary outcome pregnancies without fetal loss, intrauterine transfusion, hydrops or neonatal death, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH's Erythroblastosis, Fetal (D004899) lists Hemolytic Disease of Newborn as an entry term (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28, details?descriptor=D004899).

Both studies (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrol adults with type 1 diabetes on insulin with a BMI of 25 or more, and both have one primary outcome, change in HbA1c. The registry indexes them under Type 1 diabetes, Obesity and Overweight, but obesity is an entry criterion and glycaemic control is what reads out, so the disease is Diabetes Mellitus, Type 1 (D003922).

MK-0616-038 (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) is the Indian study of enlicitide 20 mg against placebo in adults with ASCVD or HeFH and LDL-C of 55 or 70 mg/dL or more on statins, primary outcome percent change in LDL-C at week 24, the design of CORALreef Lipids (NCT05952856), which the registry indexes under Hypercholesterolemia. The DailyMed label (set id 100ec543-fbd0-44fc-b740-db9cdff39145, published 2026-07-27, checked 2026-10-28) indicates Lipfendra to reduce LDL-C 'in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including HeFH', so the disease is Hypercholesterolemia (D006937), though the title says hyperlipidemia.

MK-8591B-060 (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) switches virologically suppressed adults with HIV-1 from BIC/FTC/TAF to once-weekly islatravir with ulonivirine, primary outcome HIV-1 RNA of 50 copies/mL or more at week 24. The registry indexes it only under Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome and Infections; the people enrolled are suppressed and exclude active AIDS-defining illness, so the disease is HIV Infections (D015658, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28).

APPEAR-C3G (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests iptacopan against placebo in biopsy-confirmed C3 glomerulopathy, primary outcome UPCR, and the registry indexes it under Proteinuria alone. MeSH lists C3G Complement 3 Glomerulopathy and Complement 3 Glomerulopathy as entry terms of Glomerulonephritis, Membranoproliferative (D015432, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28, details?descriptor=D015432), the asset's existing row. The study enrols ages 12 to 60 and its summary says the primary completion date now reflects the adolescent cohort; the FDA label (set id a76b5845-6e21-4d3b-ad07-cd8df1b60bee, effective 2026-07-16) approves Fabhalta in C3G in adults only.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) gives healthy adults one of six mRNA influenza vaccine candidates or a licensed trivalent influenza vaccine, primary outcomes reactogenicity and safety. The registry indexes it under Influenza, Human (D007251), the disease the vaccine prevents, but the sponsor's only condition is 'Healthy Adults', which shares no word with it.

POWER2 (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with focal onset epilepsy on 1 to 3 antiseizure medicines, primary outcome change in monthly focal seizure frequency; the registry indexes it under Epilepsies, Partial (D004828), which the asset has no row for. The asset's first focal-seizure trial, POWER1 (NCT06999902, same population and endpoint), is indexed under Seizures (D012640) only (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28), so focal epilepsy is the asset's Seizures row, and a separate Epilepsies, Partial row would hold one population twice.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) enrols adults with geographic atrophy secondary to AMD, excludes any macular neovascularisation, and its primary outcome is GA lesion growth on fundus autofluorescence, so the readout is in Geographic Atrophy (D057092), the narrower of the two rows the registry indexes. Pozelimab is given with cemdisiran in one arm; the other arms are cemdisiran alone and placebo.

Pagoda (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) compares the Port Delivery System with ranibizumab against monthly intravitreal ranibizumab in diabetic macular edema, primary outcome BCVA averaged over weeks 60 and 64 (the pending part is the re-implantation substudy, same population), and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH has no descriptor for DME (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28: no descriptor or term contains it); Macular Edema (D008269) is the lesion, while Diabetic Retinopathy (D003930) also holds retinopathy without edema, which the SUSVIMO label (set id 9c6d9e2a-9a77-4d11-b692-de87cfde3444, effective 2025-11-21) lists as a separate indication from DME.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) tests belumosudil with corticosteroids against placebo with corticosteroids in newly diagnosed moderate to severe chronic graft versus host disease, ages 12 and over, primary outcome event-free survival; the registry indexes it only under Bronchiolitis Obliterans Syndrome. MeSH has no chronic GVHD descriptor; the disease is Graft vs Host Disease (D006086, id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28). The FDA label (set id 102e4ef4-7f84-4e34-8df1-479c24d1575d, effective 2026-04-07) approves Rezurock in chronic GVHD from 12 years after two prior lines, so the readout is a first-line extension, not a new age group.

The study (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, checked 2026-10-28) compares VX-993 doses with pregabalin in adults with type 1 or 2 diabetes and bilateral lower-limb pain from diabetic peripheral neuropathy, primary outcome weekly average pain on the NPRS at week 12, and the registry indexes it under no MeSH term. MeSH's Diabetic Neuropathies (D003929) lists Diabetic Neuropathy, Painful as an entry term (id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/lookup, checked 2026-10-28, details?descriptor=D003929).

Glofitamab monotherapy against bendamustine-rituximab or rituximab-lenalidomide in relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma after a BTK inhibitor (registry record, read by the linking round on 2026-10-28); obinutuzumab appears only as the two pretreatment infusions, so the readout is Columvi's, in mantle cell lymphoma. MeSH D020522, Lymphoma, Mantle-Cell.
